slug: 2025-09-08 Ghana plans new framework for SIM card-digital ID linkage

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports the communications minister announced a legislative framework, to go to parliament as a bill in October 2025, linking SIM registration to the Ghana Card, with biometric SIM and device registration through a CEIR linked to the NIA database (as_of is the published date, the document giving none other).
